backend/main.mo: Actor defining user profiles, roles, admin allowlist, signup flows, access control integration, and service report storage with geolocation support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old DailyServiceReport entries to new format by adding a null geolocation field.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing geolocation-related frontend changes, affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing various frontend files, components, pages, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md: Guide for packaging the PWA as an Android TWA app using Bubblewrap or manual Android Studio setup.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment instructions for running the app locally or on mainnet, including upgrade steps and post-deploy checks.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer setting extensive OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting metadata, icons, manifest, and bootstrapping the React app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, start URL, colors, and required 192x192 and 512x512 icons.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker providing precache, runtime caching, and network-first/cache-first fetch strategies with cache cleanup logic.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router and auth-flow controller handling identity, profile loading, error states, and routing decisions.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI screen shown when a user lacks admin permissions, offering a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Top navigation bar showing branding, user ID copy tools, navigation links, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Page layout wrapper including header, footer, offline banner, and container for page content.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login and signup entry screen using Internet Identity with stale-session detection and account switching.
frontend/src/components/OfflineBanner.ts: Banner that appears when offline, warning users about limited functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Signup form for creating user profiles with validation and separate flows for engineer and admin roles.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Screen shown when authentication is invalid, prompting the user to log out and sign in again.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides a complete logout routine that clears identity, session storage, React Query cache, and reloads the page.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Offers one‑shot geolocation capture with status and error handling using the browser Geolocation API.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, exposing identity, login, logout, and status via context.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: Tracks online/offline status by listening to browser network events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls in React Query hooks for profiles, admin checks, signup, and other user/report operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for listing, deleting, and managing users, including purge and reset operations with access checks.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Fetches and displays a single service report with status, customer details, and geolocation, including loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Provides a form to create new service reports with validation, geolocation capture, and submission handling.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Lists all reports with search, filtering, CSV download, and optional user-principal filtering.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Detects whether errors relate to missing user profiles or real authentication/session failures.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears localStorage and sessionStorage keys related to Internet Identity to fully reset auth state.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Copies text to the clipboard using the modern API with a fallback textarea method.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Formats principal IDs for display and returns full IDs when needed.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts service reports to CSV and triggers a file download with geolocation and metadata fields included.
Parses and sanitizes backend signup errors to produce safe, user-friendly messages.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Provides sanitized error logging and data scrubbing utilities for the signup flow.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Contains simple validators for required fields, email addresses, and mobile numbers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles extracting, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, animations, and layout utilities with plugins.
project_state.json: Defines current project metadata, features, and pending geolocation-related feature requests.
